title: Generate the server scrubber word list from the catalogue
evidence: Step 1 (PR 1376): the word lists and regexes both scrubbers share live in packages/health-core/src/scrub-vocabulary.ts, derived from the catalogue. Step 2 (PR 1484): instrument-scrub.mjs is generated from health-core's sentry-scrub-server.ts by tools/generate-instrument-scrub.mjs (esbuild); a stand-in catalogue carries the finished lists, so the file holds none of lab-catalog's graph. Left, after the engine hold lifts: the health-core comments that still describe a hand copy (sentry-scrub-server.ts, scrub-vocabulary.ts, instrument-scrub-parity.test.ts) and retiring sentry-scrub-server-parity.test.ts, which now compares the source with its own output
